sentences.text: This application is filed under Section 5 of the Limitation Act for condonation of delay of 550 days caused in preferring the First Appeal.
2. Heard learned advocate Mr.Mohsin Hakim for the applicants.

Though served, none appeared for respondent Nos.1 and 2.
3.
Learned advocate for the applicants submitted that due to financial crunch, applicant could not manage necessary fees for the purpose of litigation.
There is no intentional delay on the part of the applicant.
Thus, there NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/6262/2024 ORDER DATED: 05/03/2025 undefined is a delay in preferring the appeal.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the present applicants are unaware of the provisions of law, which could permit them to file appeal, which is a statutory right.
He has submitted that in view of the settled principles of law in the deceision of Hon'ble Apex Court in case of K. Subbarayadu and others Vs.

The Special Deputy Collector (Land Acquisition) reported in 2017(12) SCC 840 and would submit that considering the law laid down in aforementioned case, the applicants are not claiming their right for the interest upon the enhanced compensation, if any, for the delay period from the date of judgment and award till filing of the appeal, if appellants succeed in First Appeal.

4. Considering the submissions canvassed by the learned advocate for the applicants and contentions raised in the application, it is needless to observe that in catena of decisions, the view taken by the Hon'ble Supreme Court is, while deciding an application for condonation of delay, the liberal and justice orientated approach needs to be adopted so that the substantive rights of the parties are not defeated only on the ground of delay.
To meet with the equity, delay can be condoned.

There is no intentional NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/6262/2024 ORDER DATED:
05/03/2025 undefined delay on the part of the applicants.
The delay has sufficiently been explained.

Hence, the delay is condoned subject to condition that the claimant/s shall not claim interest upon enhanced compensation, if any, for the period of delay from the date of judgment and award till filing of the appeal, if succeeds the appeal.
5.
With these observations and directions, the present Civil Application stands allowed.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.

(D. M. DESAI,J) MANOJ Ravaben Wd/O Surajgar Balgar Gosai vs Dineshbhai Virabhai Patel on 5 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150002963/
